notes:
ACCESS: Tier 1 (direct HTTP via curl) blocked — www.panemirates.com/robots.txt returned Cloudflare 520 consistently (3 attempts); www.panemirates.com/ redirects 301 to https://www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/ (site rebranded from 'Pan Emirates' to 'Pan Home', same retailer/company), and panhomestores.com is behind a Cloudflare Managed Challenge that returned 403/challenge HTML for every path including robots.txt. Tier 2 (Playwright, both headless and headed, with navigator.webdriver patched) also could not clear the Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge after repeated waits up to 20s — genuine anti-bot wall defeating tiers 1 and 2. Escalated to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real browser session), which passed the Cloudflare challenge after a short wait. robots.txt (read via Claude-in-Chrome once past the challenge) shows only generic Disallow rules (checkout, customer, my-account, search, catalog/category/view, catalog/product/view, admin dirs) — no Claude-specific UA disallow (no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entries), so proceeding was permitted. Sitemaps listed: uae_en/uae_ar (+ oman/qatar/ksa) product sitemaps.

DISCOVERY: (1) Full main-nav mega-menu inspected via DOM read (Bedroom, Sofas, Dining Room, Living Room, Modular, Household [12 sub-menus: Wall Decor, Utility & Storage, Lighting, Kitchen, Soft Furnishings, Tabletop, Bathroom, Floor Covering, Home Decor {Home Fragrance, Decor Accessories only}, Pets Supplies, Garden, View All], Office, Outdoor, Kids & Teens, Offers, Pan Blooms, Shop All) — every sub-category link extracted; none named/associated with any holiday/festival. (2) Footer link scan (37 links) — no seasonal terms. (3) Homepage full link scan — no seasonal terms. (4) Both product sitemap files (uae_en_sitemap_001.xml ~12MB/thousands of URLs, uae_en_sitemap_002.xml ~6KB) fetched and scanned for christmas/xmas/diwali/deepavali/eid/ramadan/halloween/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/holi/rakhi/navratri/dussehra/festive/festival/holiday — zero hits in file 002; file 001 had 'eid' (1 hit, false positive: product name 'Eidel ... Porcelain Dinner Set', a brand/product name unrelated to the Eid holiday) and 'ramadan' (20 URLs, all one branch: /ahlan-ramadan-with-lojain and its sub-paths). All other keywords: 0 hits. (5) Investigated the 'Ahlan Ramadan with Lojain' branch directly: root page title is 'Ahlan Ramadan with Lojain - Sale 30-70% off on Everything', breadcrumb 'Home > Ahlan With Lojain', and every nested page checked (root, /lojain-collection, /lojain-collection/azulite-collection) showed near-identical, catalog-wide item counts (1861, 1861, 1822 items respectively) with generic room facets (Bedroom/Living Room/Dining Room/Accessories) and unrelated products (e.g. outdoor metal fire pits) in the grid — i.e. this is the storewide seasonal SALE event (a Ramadan-timed clearance campaign across the entire catalog, celebrity/designer name 'Lojain' as a marketing tie-in) rather than a genuine curated Ramadan/Eid product category. Excluded per rules §4/§17 (Sale/Offers campaign page, not a real seasonal PLP) despite the nested URL/room structure, because the item counts and product mix show it is not a distinct seasonal assortment. (6) Arabic site (uae_ar) checked separately: full nav mirrors English 1:1 (same categories, translated labels only), and a full link-text scan (481 links) for رمضان/عيد/كريسماس/هالوين/فالنتاين/عام جديد/ديوالي returned zero matches. (7) Internal site search was not used as proof of absence per the shared rule (a zero-result search proves nothing) — absence is based on the mega-menu + footer + sitemap + Arabic-nav checks above, not on search.

CONCLUSION: No genuine seasonal/holiday product-listing category (Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, or any Indian/regional festival) exists anywhere in Pan Home / Pan Emirates UAE's real navigation, sitemap, or Arabic-language structure. The one Ramadan-named branch found is a storewide sale/clearance campaign, not a seasonal category, and was excluded as a marketing/promotional page per the boundary rules.
